description:
Use when someone asks what a watch or dealer term, abbreviation or nickname means, such as BNIB, LNIB, full set, hesalite, grey market, Hulk or Pepsi.
term: the word or phrase as written.
Returns JSON from Moda's glossary of about 276 terms: the meaning, an example where there is one, the references a nickname stands for, and the glossary link. Up to three close matches when the term is not exact.
name: explain_watch_term
title: Explain a watch-trade term
